articles.title: The Save Button That Swallowed Letters
articles.summary: A new postal terminal has a button marked Save, and every sender assumes a letter that disappears has begun its journey.
articles.summaryZh: 新邮亭里有一个写着“保存”的按钮，寄信人每次按下它，都以为信已经上路。
storyParagraphs: The city introduced electronic postal terminals. After composing a letter, users saw one prominent Save button. Pressing it made the letter disappear and returned the screen to a blank page. Many took this to mean the letter had been sent.

In reality, Save placed the message in a private drafts folder. Sending required another menu. Designers understood the internal structure and considered the two steps clear. Ordinary users relied on experience with paper mail: once a letter left the desk, the post office had it.

After a month, birthday letters and payment notices remained in drafts. Instructions had been posted, but few people read them before acting. The explanation users had formed continued to conflict with the machine's behaviour, creating repeated error.

The designers separated the actions visibly. Saving kept the message on screen with the label 'Visible only to you'. Sending used a paper-plane symbol and then displayed recipient, time, and 'Accepted by post'. Leaving with an unsent message triggered a clear warning.
The next sender did not walk away after pressing Send. She waited until the recipient's name appeared before taking her hand from the terminal.
storyParagraphsZh: 城里启用电子邮亭。写完信后，屏幕上只有一个显眼的“保存”按钮。寄信人按下以后，信件从画面消失，机器又回到空白页。许多人据此相信信已经被送走。
实际上，“保存”只把信放进私人草稿箱，真正发送还要打开另一层菜单。系统设计者熟悉内部结构，觉得两步十分清楚；普通人却依据纸信经验判断：信一旦离开桌面，就已经交给邮局。
一个月后，大量生日信和付款通知仍躺在草稿箱。说明书早已张贴，却很少有人在操作前阅读。用户形成的解释与机器真实行为持续错位，错误便一次次重复。
设计者把两个动作分开呈现：保存后，信仍留在画面并标记“仅自己可见”；发送按钮使用纸飞机图标，按下后显示收件人、时间和“已交付邮局”。离开页面前，未发送的信还会得到明确提醒。
下一位寄信人按下发送后，没有立即走开。她等到屏幕出现收件人姓名，才把手从机器上移开。
articles.conceptNameZh: 人机交互中的心智模型
explanationParagraphs: A mental model in human-computer interaction is the explanation users form from experience, cues, feedback, and learning to predict system behaviour; it need not mirror implementation. Labels, mappings, constraints, state visibility, and feedback shape it. When the presented model repeatedly conflicts with real behaviour, documentation alone rarely fixes systematic error.
explanationParagraphsZh: 人机交互中的心智模型是用户依据经验、线索、反馈和学习形成的系统解释，用来预测操作结果，不必等同底层实现。设计通过标签、映射、约束、状态可见性和反馈塑造模型。若呈现持续违背真实行为，单靠说明书难以修复系统性错误。

articles.title: The Archive with One Enormous Desktop
articles.titleZh: 只有一张巨大桌面的档案馆
articles.summary: An archive lays every file across one table; nothing is lost, but no one can tell where anything belongs.
articles.summaryZh: 档案馆把所有文件平铺在一张桌上，东西一件没丢，人们却再也找不到它们属于哪里。
storyParagraphs: The new archive had no cabinets, only one enormous table filling the hall. Every file lay on it, and a search clerk could find items by title. While the collection was small, this openness seemed convenient; no one needed to remember a drawer.

Years later, projects, dates, departments, and drafts mixed together. Dozens of files shared the title 'Budget'. When an old project ended, nobody knew which drawings should expire with it. Permissions were set one item at a time. The growing table resembled a city without streets.

Archivists built nested cabinets by organisation, project, and year. A file acquired context through its path, while a parent could pass down permissions and retention rules. Finding 'Year Two Budget for the River Bridge' no longer meant searching every paper called Budget.

Some records still belonged to several projects. Rather than copying them into two places, the archive used stable identifiers, tags, references, and search to express cross-links. The hierarchy provided a principal address; other tools provided side roads.
When the last loose sheet entered a cabinet, the table's wood became visible. The archivists kept one small area for new items whose place had not yet been decided.
storyParagraphsZh: 新档案馆没有柜子，只有一张占满大厅的巨大桌面。每份文件都放在上面，搜索员也能按标题找到它。起初资料不多，这种开放看起来方便，谁都不必记住抽屉位置。
几年后，项目、年份、部门和草稿混在一起。同名的“预算”有几十份，删除一个旧项目时，没人知道哪些图纸与它一同到期。权限也只能逐份设置，文件越多，桌面越像一片没有街道的城市。
馆员按机构、项目和年份建立嵌套柜架，让文件沿路径获得上下文，父级还可传递权限与保存规则。查找“河桥项目的二年预算”不再等同于搜索所有叫预算的纸。
但有些文件同时关联多个项目。馆员没有强迫它们复制到两处，而是使用稳定编号、标签、引用和搜索连接交叉关系。层级提供主要住址，其他工具提供旁路。
最后一张散纸归档时，桌面终于露出木纹。馆员仍留下一小块空处，专放尚未确定位置的新文件。
explanationParagraphs: Hierarchical information organisation places items in nested parent-child containers, providing paths for navigation, scope, context, and inherited rules. A hierarchy cannot express every cross-relationship, so stable identifiers, metadata, tags, search, references, permissions, and version control remain complementary. A clear primary tree need not force all relationships into a tree.
explanationParagraphsZh: 层级化信息组织把项目放入嵌套父子容器，为导航、范围、情境和继承规则提供路径。层级不能表达全部交叉关系，因此还需稳定标识、元数据、标签、搜索、引用、权限与版本控制。主要层级应清楚，但不必强迫所有关系都变成树。

articles.title: The Clerk with Every Key
articles.summary: For convenience, city hall gives one clerk every key until he loses the ring.
articles.summaryZh: 为图方便，市政厅把所有房间的钥匙交给一名书记，直到他丢了一只钥匙环。
storyParagraphs: City clerk Gu Yan delivered records among departments. To avoid borrowing keys each time, his supervisor gave him access to the archive, treasury, seal room, and equipment store. Gu Yan worked quickly and never abused it, but the ring could open far more than his daily duties required.

One day, he lost the ring at the market. Whoever found it wanted only the treasury but gained access to records and official seals as well. The city replaced every lock overnight. The breadth of harm came from the keys' capability, not Gu Yan's intention.

After redesign, Gu Yan kept only a card for his delivery route. Treasury access required a finance officer. Temporary tasks received time-limited rights with logs and automatic expiry, while high-risk actions required another identity check.

At first, restrictions were too narrow and clerks began lending cards. The supervisor redesigned roles around real work instead of accumulating exceptions. Rights were reviewed each season and removed immediately after role changes.
On his next delivery, Gu Yan carried one card. At the treasury it did not light, so he turned to find the person who was meant to accompany him.
storyParagraphsZh: 市政厅的书记顾言常替不同部门送文件。为了免去逐次借钥匙，主管把档案室、金库、印章房和设备间的钥匙全交给他。顾言工作很快，也从未滥用，但那串钥匙始终能打开远超他日常任务的门。
一天，顾言在集市丢了钥匙环。捡到的人虽只想偷金库，却同时获得档案与印章房入口。市政厅不得不连夜换掉所有门锁，影响范围来自钥匙拥有的能力，而不是顾言本人的意图。
重设以后，顾言只保留送件路线需要的门卡。进入金库要由财务人员同行，临时任务可申请限时权限，使用会留下日志，任务结束自动撤销。高风险操作还要求再次确认身份。
最初限制过紧，书记们开始互借卡片。主管因此按实际工作重新设计角色，而不是不断添加例外。权限每季复核，离职或换岗当天撤回，不让旧能力慢慢堆积。
顾言再次去送文件时，腰间只有一张门卡。走到金库前，卡片没有亮，他转身去找应当同行的人。
explanationParagraphs: The principle of least privilege gives users, processes, or devices only the permissions needed for a defined task and period, reducing the impact of mistakes or compromise. Roles, separation of duties, temporary elevation, logging, reauthentication, and prompt revocation support it. Controls must remain usable and reviewed to prevent workarounds and privilege creep.
explanationParagraphsZh: 最小权限原则让用户、进程或设备只在必要时段拥有完成明确任务所需的权限，以缩小误用或被攻破时的影响。角色、职责分离、限时提升、日志、再认证和及时撤权都可支持。控制也要可用并定期复核，避免绕过与权限膨胀。

articles.fieldTitle: Database and network design and administration
articles.fieldTitleZh: 数据库与网络设计及管理
articles.title: The Address Written in Seven Registers
articles.titleZh: 写在七本名册里的地址
articles.summary: A shop copies one customer's address into seven books; after she moves, deliveries reach four different places.
articles.summaryZh: 一家商铺把同一位顾客的地址抄进七本账，搬家以后，货物被送到了四个不同地方。
storyParagraphs: A cloth shop kept separate registers for orders, returns, membership, debt, delivery, repairs, and festivals. Mrs Lin's name and address appeared in all seven. When she moved, she told only the delivery clerk; six books retained the old address.

Orders reached the new home, refund letters went to the old street, and a repaired item travelled to an earlier temporary address. Deleting her last order almost removed the only remaining contact details. One fact scattered across many places created contradictions during update, insertion, and deletion.

The bookkeeper placed customer details in one register identified by customer number. Orders, returns, and repairs stored that number and their own facts. Address was maintained in one proper place and linked when needed. Joining the separated records still reconstructed the original business information.

Not every value had to be split into the smallest possible piece. Controlled copies could support frequent reports, but their source, refresh rule, and consistency owner had to be explicit. Important constraints could not disappear during decomposition.
When Mrs Lin moved again, the clerk changed one row. All seven business activities pointed to the new door at their next lookup.
storyParagraphsZh: 布庄为订单、退货、会员、欠款、送货、维修和节庆各设一本名册。顾客林太太的姓名与地址在七处重复。她搬家时只通知送货员，其他六本仍保留旧址。
随后，订单送到新家，退款信去了旧街，维修品被送到她更早的临时住处。删除最后一笔订单时，伙计还险些把她唯一的联系方式一并擦掉。同一事实散在多处，更新、插入和删除都会制造新矛盾。
账房把顾客资料放进一张以顾客编号识别的名册，订单、退货和维修只保存编号与各自事实。地址只在一个合适位置维护，需要时通过编号关联。拆分后重新组合，仍能还原原有业务记录。
并非所有内容都要切成最小碎片。常用报表为性能可保存受控副本，但来源、刷新规则和一致性责任必须明确。约束也不能因拆表而丢失。
林太太再次改地址时，伙计只改了一行。七项业务在下次查询时一同指向了新门牌。
explanationParagraphs: Database normalisation organises facts by keys and functional dependencies so that each belongs in an appropriate relation, reducing insertion, update, and deletion anomalies. Good decomposition should be lossless and preserve important constraints where possible. Normal forms guide design; performance, history, and controlled denormalisation still require explicit trade-offs and maintenance.
explanationParagraphsZh: 数据库规范化依据键与函数依赖把事实放在恰当关系中，减少插入、更新和删除异常。良好分解应无损，并尽可能保留重要约束。范式是设计指南，不是绝对目标；性能、历史和受控反规范化仍需明确权衡与维护规则。

articles.fieldTitle: Database and network design and administration
articles.fieldTitleZh: 数据库与网络设计及管理
articles.title: The Ship That Departed Twice
articles.summary: Five signal towers keep a shared sailing log; when the leader falls silent, old and new orders send one ship twice.
articles.summaryZh: 五座信号塔在浓雾中各自保存航令，旧塔失声后，新旧命令让同一艘船出发了两次。
storyParagraphs: Five harbour towers jointly recorded ship departures. A lead tower issued an order and the others copied it, allowing work to continue after one failure. In heavy fog, the leader ordered Morning Star to depart and then lost contact. Only two towers received the message.

The other three could not see that entry. They chose a new leader and approved Morning Star's departure again. When the fog cleared, both versions claimed authority. A delayed old message remained in transit while the new leader had extended its log. Accepting either freely could commit conflicting orders.

The revised system gave each leader an increasing term. An entry required confirmation from an overlapping majority to commit. A new leader first carried the newest log known by its majority, and messages from older terms were rejected. Any two deciding majorities shared at least one tower carrying prior commitments.

During complete partition, the minority side stopped issuing new orders rather than risk conflict; progress resumed only after enough towers communicated. Crashes, malicious nodes, and membership change required more specific rules, and 'copied to a majority' was not universally sufficient.
At the next leader failure, Morning Star accepted only one order bearing a term and commit mark. The delayed alternative went onto the obsolete rack.
storyParagraphsZh: 港湾由五座信号塔共同记录船只出发。领塔发出航令，其余塔抄入日志；即使一座停电，港口仍希望继续工作。一次浓雾中，领塔发出“晨星号出发”后失去联系，消息只到达两座塔。
另外三座看不见这条记录，选出新领塔，又批准晨星号出发。雾散后，两个版本都声称有效：旧领塔的延迟消息仍在路上，新领塔则已经继续写日志。若各塔随便接受，港口可能提交冲突顺序。
新规则给每位领塔一个递增任期。只有获得相互交叠的多数确认，记录才可提交；新领塔必须先带上多数塔已知的最新日志，旧任期消息一到便被拒绝。这样，任何两个作出决定的多数至少共享一座能携带既有记录的塔。
通信完全分裂时，少数一侧宁可暂时不发新航令，以守住不冲突的记录；恢复推进则取决于足够塔重新通信。崩溃、恶意节点和成员更换还需要更具体规则，简单“复制到多数”并非任何协议都足够。
下一次领塔失声，晨星号只收到一张带任期与提交章的航令。另一张延迟到达时，被挂进了废止栏。
explanationParagraphs: Distributed consensus enables multiple nodes to agree on a value or ordered log despite failures and delayed messages. Safety prevents conflicting commitments; liveness seeks progress when communication and fault assumptions permit. Terms, overlapping majorities, replicated logs, and explicit commit rules are common tools, while partitions, Byzantine faults, and membership change require additional design.
explanationParagraphsZh: 分布式共识让多个节点在故障和消息延迟下对值或有序日志达成一致。安全性防止冲突提交，活性则在通信与故障假设允许时推进。任期、交叠多数、复制日志和明确提交规则是常见机制；分区、恶意故障与成员变化需要额外设计。

articles.title: The Vault with Only One Door
articles.summary: A city stakes the safety of its treasury on one celebrated lock, until a stolen badge makes the lock irrelevant.
articles.summaryZh: 城里的银库把全部安全都押在一把名锁上，直到一枚被盗的腰牌让那把锁变得毫无用处。
storyParagraphs: When the city built a new treasury, the keeper gave most of the budget to a locksmith famous across the region. The bronze door had three rows of bolts. An axe could not split it, and fire could not burn through it. On opening day, he invited the townspeople to watch and pulled the door three times with his own hands. It did not move.

One winter night, a coal carrier arrived wearing a badge stolen from the accounts office. The guard recognized its red seal and let him into the courtyard. The costly bronze door remained securely locked. The carrier entered through the smaller door used by clerks during the day.

Every room inside used the same kind of key. The carrier took one from a wall hook and opened the accounts office, the weighing room, and the rear store in turn. He did not empty the treasury. He took a little from more than a dozen chests and returned the altered ledger pages to their places. Three days passed before an apprentice noticed a broken line in the dust on one chest and discovered that silver was missing.

The keeper did not remove the bronze door. He gave the courtyard, the accounts office, and the silver rooms to different custodians. Entering the vault now required two keys turned together. Chest seals were checked each day, unusual movement rang a bell in the inner court, and a second copy of the ledger was locked across the river. When someone asked why so much trouble was needed with such a strong door, the keeper looked at the stolen badge. 'The door stopped only those who had no key,' he said.
Afterward, he hung the golden sample key given to him by the locksmith on his study wall. It still shone, but it no longer opened a single door in the treasury.
storyParagraphsZh: 城里新建银库时，司库把大半预算给了远近闻名的锁匠。铜门有三层锁舌，斧头砍不动，火也烧不穿。落成那天，他让百姓排队观看，亲手拉了三次门，门纹丝不动。
入冬后的一晚，一名送炭人戴着账房失窃的腰牌来到门前。守卫认得腰牌上的红漆，便放他进了院子。那扇名贵的铜门仍好好锁着，送炭人走的是白天供伙计出入的小门。
库里所有房间都用同一种钥匙。送炭人从墙钩上取下一把，依次打开账房、称银间和后仓。他没有搬空银库，只从十几个箱子里各取一点，又把改过的账页放回原处。直到三天后，一个学徒发现某只箱子的灰尘断了一线，众人才知道银子少了。
司库没有拆掉铜门。他把院门、账房和银仓分给不同的人管理；进银仓要两把钥匙同时转动；箱封每天核对，异动会敲响内院的铃；账册另抄一份，锁在河对岸。有人问，铜门已经这样牢，何必再添麻烦。司库看着那枚失窃的腰牌说：‘门只拦住了没有钥匙的人。’
后来，他把锁匠赠送的那把金色样钥挂在书房墙上。它仍旧闪亮，却再也打不开银库里的任何一扇门。
explanationParagraphs: Defense in depth avoids relying on a single security barrier. It combines prevention, limited privileges, separation, detection, and recovery so that the controls support one another. Any layer can be bypassed, fail, or be defeated by stolen credentials; multiple layers keep one breach from becoming a complete loss. The bronze door, divided keys, tamper seals, alarms, and off-site ledger each serve a different protective function.
explanationParagraphsZh: 纵深防御不把安全寄托在单一屏障上，而是让预防、权限限制、隔离、检测和恢复彼此补位。任何一道防线都可能被绕过、失灵或凭据被盗；多层控制的价值，在于一次突破不会直接变成完整损失。故事中的铜门、分权钥匙、箱封警报和异地账册分别承担不同防护作用。

articles.fieldTitleZh: 软件与应用开发及分析
articles.title: The Theatre That Stopped for One Puppet
articles.titleZh: 换一只木偶就要停演的剧场
articles.summary: A mechanist drives an entire theatre from one main shaft, saving parts until a single new puppet brings down the whole performance.
articles.summaryZh: 机关师用一根主轴驱动整座剧场，省下许多零件，也让一只新木偶拖垮了整场演出。
storyParagraphs: Willow River Theatre was poor enough to own only one set of machinery. Its mechanist connected the curtain, lamp frame, drumstick, and twelve puppets to a single main shaft. When the shaft turned, the curtain rose, the shades opened, and the drum sounded exactly as the puppets began to walk. The manager saved the price of many gears and boasted that the machine contained nothing unnecessary.

Before a new play opened, mice ruined the face of the queen puppet. A carpenter hurriedly made another. It was more beautiful and only two pounds heavier. The mechanist hung it in place, watched it walk once, and told the company to admit the audience. The house was full that night, with the county magistrate seated in the first row.

As the queen reached centre stage, the main shaft slowed for a beat. The drumstick missed, the curtain dropped halfway, and the lamp frame kept turning. An oil lamp struck the edge of the cloth. Actors rushed to put out the flame while all twelve puppets continued bowing in the smoke. The audience fled into the street, and the magistrate's new robe was soaked by a bucket of water.

During repairs, the mechanist found that replacing one cord on the queen required removing the drum frame first; adjusting a lamp changed the moment when the curtain fell. He cut the main shaft apart. Lamps, drum, curtain, and puppets each received their own mechanism, joined only by hooks of the same size and a few agreed signals from a bronze bell. A role could now be changed by hanging a puppet on the hooks and listening for the bell.

The following year, the wolf puppet broke a leg just before the opening. An apprentice brought the spare and fastened its two hooks. The first bell had already sounded beyond the curtain, and the manager did not even ask the drummer to stop.
storyParagraphsZh: 柳河剧场穷得只剩一套机关。机关师把幕布、灯架、鼓槌和十二只木偶都接在同一根主轴上。轴一转，幕布升起，灯罩打开，鼓声和木偶的脚步正好同时响。班主少买了许多齿轮，逢人便夸这台机器没有一处多余。
新戏开演前，王后木偶的脸被老鼠咬坏了。木匠赶做了一只，模样更美，只比旧的重两斤。机关师把它挂上去试了试，木偶能走，便催大家开门迎客。那晚座无虚席，县令也坐在第一排。
王后走到台中央时，主轴忽然慢了一拍。鼓槌先落空，幕布随后垂下一半，灯架却还在往前转。一盏油灯撞上布边，演员扑上去灭火，十二只木偶则在烟里不停鞠躬。观众逃到街上，县令的新袍被水浇得透湿。
修理时，机关师发现若要替王后换一根绳，就得先卸下鼓架；要调灯，又会改变幕布落下的时刻。他把主轴锯开，让灯、鼓、幕布和木偶各用自己的机关，只留下尺寸相同的挂钩和几声约定好的铜铃。以后换角色，只需把木偶挂上，听铃行动。
第二年，狼木偶在开场前断了一条腿。小学徒抱来备用木偶，扣上两只挂钩。幕外已经响起第一声铜铃，班主甚至没有叫停鼓手。
explanationParagraphs: Modularity divides a complex system into parts with clear responsibilities and relative internal independence, connected through stable interfaces. The aim is not to remove all relationships between parts, but to control dependencies so that a change, replacement, or failure in one part spreads as little as possible. The theatre's separate mechanisms, standard hooks, and bell signals represent module boundaries and interfaces.
explanationParagraphsZh: 模块化把复杂系统分成职责清楚、内部相对独立的部分，并通过稳定接口连接。它的目的不是让部件彼此毫无关系，而是控制依赖，使一个部件的修改、替换或故障尽量不扩散到全局。剧场后来使用独立机关、统一挂钩和铜铃信号，分别对应模块边界与接口。

articles.fieldTitle: Software and applications development and analysis
articles.fieldTitleZh: 软件与应用开发及分析
articles.title: The Stage That Was Perfect Only When Empty
articles.titleZh: 只在空场里完美的舞台
articles.summary: An automated stage is rushed into service before a festival; every mechanism behaves in an empty hall until actors and rain arrive together.
articles.summaryZh: 一座自动舞台赶在庆典前完工，空场时每个机关都很听话，直到演员和暴雨同时登台。
storyParagraphs: Before the harvest festival, the theatre built a stage that could change its own scenery. The manager promised the governor that opening night would not contain a single dark pause. Carpenters had raised the curtain, lifted the bridge, and opened the trapdoor separately; each worked smoothly. The stage master asked for one complete run with actors in costume, but the manager would not give up the daytime rehearsals for which he was selling tickets.

Heavy rain fell on opening night. The actor playing the knight rushed onto the bridge in a cloak soaked with water just as the backstage bell signalled a change of scene. The bridge moved a moment more slowly than it had when empty, but the curtain fell on time and wrapped itself around the knight's raised lance. Hearing a second bell, the trapdoor operator assumed the first act was over and pulled his lever as well.

The knight fell into a padded compartment and escaped serious injury. His falling lance struck the scenery, however, and covered the front row in dust. The governor left amid coughing, and tickets for the remaining three performances were refunded. Alone on the empty stage, the manager pulled every mechanism again. Once again, each worked perfectly.

The actors, carpenters, and stage master all stayed for the repairs. They first loaded each mechanism with the heaviest prop, then tried actions that could occur at the same time. Someone deliberately rang a bell late; someone else soaked the cloak. After reopening, every fault and near miss was written in a small backstage book and addressed before the next day's rehearsal.

Before the premiere of the next play, the manager poured a bucket of water over the spare cloak himself. When the dripping knight stepped onto the bridge, he did not look to see whether every seat had sold. He watched the white load mark beneath the bridge.
storyParagraphsZh: 丰收节前，剧院造了一座会自己换景的舞台。班主答应总督，开幕夜绝不让观众等一次黑场。木匠分别拉过幕布、升过吊桥、开过活板门，每样都顺利。舞台师请求让演员穿戏服完整走一遍，班主却舍不得停掉白天的卖票彩排。
开幕当晚下起大雨。扮骑士的演员披着吸满水的斗篷冲上吊桥，后台同时敲响换景铃。桥比空载时慢了一瞬，幕布却照旧落下，正好缠住骑士举起的长枪。负责活板门的人听见第二声铃，以为第一幕已经结束，也拉下了手柄。
骑士跌进铺着软垫的暗格，没受重伤；倒下的长枪却撞翻布景，台下第一排被灰尘盖住。总督在咳嗽声中离席，余下三场演出全部退票。班主站在空台上反复拉动机关，它们又一次次完美运行。
修台时，演员、木匠和舞台师都留下来。他们先让每件机关单独承受最重的道具，再把会同时发生的动作连起来试；有人故意晚敲一声铃，有人往斗篷上泼水。重开以后，每场故障和险情都记在后台小册上，第二天排演前先处理。
新戏首演前，班主亲手把一桶水倒在备用斗篷上。湿漉漉的骑士踏上吊桥时，他没有去看座位卖满没有，只盯着桥下那条白色刻线。
explanationParagraphs: Software testing and feedback reduce delivery risk through evidence at several levels: individual components, their interactions, complete workflows, exceptional conditions, and real operation. Tests cannot prove that a system will never fail; they expose faults under specified conditions and increase confidence. Monitoring, incident records, and corrective feedback after release remain part of the quality cycle. Success in an empty hall says little about simultaneous changes in load, timing, and environment.
explanationParagraphsZh: 软件测试与反馈用不同层次的证据降低交付风险：既检查单个部件，也检查部件组合、完整流程、异常条件和真实运行。测试不能证明系统永远无错，只能在特定条件下发现问题并增加信心；上线后的监测、故障记录和修复反馈同样属于质量循环。空场正常，并不代表负载、时序与环境同时变化时仍然正常。

articles.title: After the Library Doubled
articles.summary: A librarian prides himself on never missing a match, until a new collection makes his reliable method demand four times as many nights.
articles.summaryZh: 一名馆长以从不漏查为荣，直到一批新书让他原本可靠的办法需要四倍长夜。
storyParagraphs: Director Zhao had one rule at the county library: every new book had to be compared with every volume already held, both to prevent duplicates and to discover related works. While the collection was small, the method was dependable. Zhao always finished before closing and often said that going slowly was how one avoided missing things.

In spring, a local landowner donated his entire collection, exactly doubling the number of books in the library. Zhao added two lamps and kept his old rule. He expected twice the work. Within days, however, comparison sheets were piling up faster and faster: the new books had to be checked against the old ones, and also against one another.

At the end of the month, the magistrate requested flood records from three generations. Zhao and six copyists worked all night and were still turning through books at dawn. The donated volumes blocked the aisles, and a later cart had to stand outside in the rain. Zhao proposed hiring six more people. A young apprentice instead pushed a small wooden box toward him, with cards divided by title, author, and river name.

They gave every book a fixed number and placed common clues in separate drawers. To find a duplicate, they no longer introduced each book to the whole library; they checked only the small group likely to match. To find flood records, they followed the cards directly to the relevant shelves. Organizing the box took half a month, but when another cart arrived, the night shift grew by only half an hour.

Zhao did not throw away the old stack of comparison sheets. He cut them into cards and placed them in the emptiest drawer of the box. When he closed the library that evening, the sunset was still visible outside, and neither of the two extra lamps had been lit.
storyParagraphsZh: 县图书馆的赵馆长有一条规矩：每收一册新书，都要把它同馆内每一册旧书逐一比较，以免重收，也方便找出相近内容。藏书不多时，这办法很稳妥。馆长总能在闭馆前做完，还常说，慢一点才不会漏掉东西。
春天，一位乡绅把家藏全数捐来，馆里的书恰好翻了一倍。赵馆长添了两盏灯，仍按旧规矩查书。他原以为工作也只会多一倍，几天后却发现桌上的对照纸越来越快地堆高：新来的书要查旧书，也要彼此再查一遍。
月底，知县要找三代水患记录。赵馆长和六名抄书人熬了整夜，仍在一册册翻。乡绅的书已挡住过道，后来的书车只好停在雨里。赵馆长想再雇六个人，年轻学徒却把一只小木盒推到他面前，盒里按书名、作者和河流名称分着卡片。
他们先给书固定编号，再把常用线索写进不同抽屉。查重时不再让每本书与全馆相见，只查看可能相同的那一小组；找水患，也先沿卡片走到对应书架。整理木盒花了半个月，但此后又来一车书，夜班只多了半个时辰。
赵馆长没有丢掉那叠旧对照纸。他把它裁成卡片，放进木盒最空的抽屉。那天闭馆时，门外还亮着晚霞，两盏加出来的油灯都没有点。
explanationParagraphs: Computational complexity examines how an algorithm's time or space requirements grow with input size. Zhao's all-pairs comparisons create roughly quadratic work, so doubling the collection brings close to four times as many comparisons. An index costs preparation and storage but sharply narrows each search. A method must therefore be judged not only by whether it works on a small input, but by its growth rate and practical resource limits.
explanationParagraphsZh: 计算复杂度研究算法所需时间或空间怎样随输入规模增长。馆长的逐一配对会产生近似平方级的工作量，藏书翻倍时，对照次数接近四倍；索引需要额外整理和存储，却能显著减少查找范围。评价方法时，不能只看小规模下是否可用，还要看增长速度和现实资源上限。

articles.title: The Three Missing Barrels of Blue
articles.summary: Three barrels of blue dye go missing from a workshop; its owner locks the gate before realizing he has never looked beyond the vats.
articles.summaryZh: 染坊少了三桶蓝料，老板先锁住院门，随后才发现自己从未认真看过染缸之外。
storyParagraphs: At the end of the month, the dye workshop counted enough purchased blue pigment for ten barrels, while the cloth sold accounted for only seven. Owner Shen Tong snapped the beads of his abacus and decided that someone was stealing. He locked the courtyard gate, searched the workers' cupboards, and withheld two days of wages from everyone.

Aman, who washed the cloth, did not argue. She brought him three bowls. One held blue water from the drain, another held blue sludge scraped from the bottom of a vat, and the third contained newly dyed cloth still dripping wet. 'The ledger records only dry cloth,' she said. 'Where are these recorded?'

Still suspicious, Shen marked the next batch of pigment. They weighed the blue entering the workshop, the dry and wet cloth, the sediment, and the discharged water. They also measured what remained in each vat before and after the work. Instead of finding a worker with a hidden supply, they found several destinations that had never been recorded: some pigment remained in vats and wet cloth, some left with sludge and water, and the old scale consistently overstated what entered.

Shen returned the withheld wages. He added a settling pond at the drain and sent recoverable blue sludge back to the start of the process. From then on, each batch began with a clear account of where material entered and left, while changes inside the vats appeared on the same page. Any remaining difference prompted a search for leaks, measurement error, or unexpected change.
The next month's account was short by only half a bowl of blue. Shen did not lock the gate. He carried the old scale to a corner of the yard and broke its beam with one hammer blow.
storyParagraphsZh: 染坊月底盘账，买来的蓝料足有十桶，卖出的布却只用得上七桶。老板沈同把账盘拨得噼啪响，认定有人偷料。他锁住院门，搜了工人的柜子，还扣下所有人的两日工钱。
洗布的阿满没有替自己争辩，只端来三只碗。一只盛着排水沟里的蓝水，一只装着刮自缸底的蓝泥，第三只碗里泡着刚出缸、仍在滴水的布。她问：‘账上只写了干布，那这些算在哪里？’
沈同仍不放心，便在下一批料上做了记号。他们称过进门的蓝料，也称干布、湿布、缸底沉积和排出的水；开工前后，连缸里剩下多少都量了一遍。最后找到的不是一个藏料的工人，而是几处长期没人记的去向：一部分留在缸和湿布里，一部分随泥与水流走，旧秤还总把进料报得偏多。
沈同把扣下的工钱退回去，又在排水口加了沉淀池，把还能回收的蓝泥送回前段。此后每批染料都要先画清从哪里进、从哪里出，缸内增减也记在同一张纸上。若仍有差额，才去查泄漏、误差或意外变化。
第二个月盘账时，账房只差了半碗蓝料。沈同没有锁门。他拿起那只旧秤，走到院角，一锤砸断了秤梁。
explanationParagraphs: Mass balance tracks material within a chosen boundary through conservation: input plus generation, minus output and consumption, equals the change in accumulation. Applying it requires a stated boundary, time basis, and measurement method, with inventories, products, waste streams, reactions, leaks, and measurement error considered. A discrepancy does not mean matter vanished; it indicates an unrecognized destination or transformation.
explanationParagraphsZh: 物料衡算依据守恒关系追踪选定边界内的物质：输入加生成，减去输出与消耗，等于积累变化。使用时必须先说明边界、时间基准和计量方式，并把库存、产品、废物流、反应、泄漏与测量误差纳入检查。差额不是物质凭空消失，而是提示仍有流向或变化尚未被识别。

articles.title: The First Drop to Escape
articles.summary: Two equal fermenters receive and release liquid at the same rate, yet make different wine until a red thread reveals an unseen shortcut inside one vessel.
articles.summaryZh: 两只同样大小的发酵罐有着相同进出速度，酿出的酒却不同，直到一缕红色显出罐内看不见的近路。
storyParagraphs: A winery installed two fermenting vessels of equal size. Each day, the same amount of juice entered each one and the same amount of wine left. By the owner's calculation, the juice should remain inside both vessels for the same length of time. Yet the eastern vessel produced mellow wine, while the western one produced wine that was partly sharp and partly overripe and sour.

The owner changed the fruit, questioned the vessel keeper, and weighed the yeast three times. Nothing improved. A young winemaker climbed to the top of the western vessel and noticed that its inlet pipe stood close to the outlet, while almost no water could be heard in two lower corners. She asked the owner not to discard the next batch, but to lend her one spoonful of red berry juice.

Soon after the berry juice entered from above, a red thread appeared at the outlet. Three days later, after clear juice had been used to flush the vessel, pale red liquid was still seeping from the bottom. Some fresh juice had taken a shortcut out before it could ferment, while some had remained trapped in the corners for too long. The average written in the ledger described neither group well.

They moved the inlet pipe to the far side and placed baffles inside so the liquid travelled through the whole vessel. After the change, red no longer appeared at the outlet immediately or lingered at the bottom for days. Batch after batch from the western vessel finally became consistent.

On the day they filled the new wine barrels, the owner poured in another spoonful of berry juice. He crouched beside the outlet and did not hurry to collect the wine. He simply placed an empty cup where the first red thread used to appear.
storyParagraphsZh: 酒坊添了两只同样大的发酵罐。每天灌入的果汁一样多，流出的酒也一样多，掌柜算过，果汁在两只罐里理应停留同样久。可东罐的酒醇厚，西罐出来的却一半发涩，一半带着过熟的酸味。
掌柜换过果子，责问过看罐人，还把酵母称了三遍。西罐仍旧如此。年轻酿酒师爬上罐顶，发现进料管和出料口离得很近，而罐底两角几乎没有水声。她请掌柜先别倒掉下一批酒，只借一勺红莓汁。
红莓汁刚从上方灌入，出口很快就出现一缕红线；可三天后，他们用清水果汁冲洗，罐底仍慢慢渗出淡红。原来一部分新汁抄近路离开，尚未来得及发酵；另一部分困在角落，待得太久。账上那个平均数，两边都没有照顾到。
他们把进料管移到远端，又在罐里加了几块导流板，让液体绕过整个罐身。改好后，红色不再立即出现在出口，也不再数日留在底部。西罐的酒终于同一批一批地稳定下来。
新酒装桶那天，掌柜又倒进一勺红莓汁。他蹲在出口旁，没有急着接酒，只把一只空杯放在第一缕红色原本会出现的地方。
explanationParagraphs: Residence time describes how long material spends inside a piece of equipment or system. Volume divided by flow gives only a nominal average. Real fluid has a distribution: short-circuiting lets some material leave too early, while dead zones hold some too long. Tracer tests, mixing patterns, and equipment geometry can reveal and improve that distribution, which often determines reaction or treatment performance.
explanationParagraphsZh: 停留时间描述物料在设备或系统内经历多久。体积除以流量只给出名义平均值，真实流体可能形成停留时间分布：短路流使部分物料过早离开，死区则让部分物料滞留过久。示踪实验、混合方式和设备几何可帮助识别并改善这种差异，而反应或处理效果往往取决于整条分布。

articles.title: The Tower Checked Only at Sunset
articles.summary: A perfume works inspects its still only at sunset; one large, delayed correction turns a small daytime drift into an overnight failure.
articles.summaryZh: 香油坊每天只在日落时检查蒸馏塔，一次迟来的大幅调整，把白天的小偏差推成了整夜的事故。
storyParagraphs: A mountain perfume works had a tall distillation tower. At sunset each day, the old owner collected a cup from the top, smelled its fragrance, and adjusted the steam valve by experience. While all the fruit peel came from one orchard, this method rarely failed, and he considered extra inspections a waste of labour.

In a poor harvest year, peel began arriving from three places. Some was dry; some still carried rainwater. A cart of wet material arrived at noon. The tower temperature slowly fell and the oil grew weaker, but no one discovered it until sunset. The owner opened the steam valve wide, hoping to recover the fragrance lost during the day. During the night, dry material replaced the wet feed, the temperature surged, and bitter compounds entered the oil.

The night apprentice heard an unfamiliar knocking in the tower and hurried to close the valve. Half a day of weak oil and half a night of bitter oil could not be sold, leaving only half the orders ready for wedding season. Looking at his sunset sample, the owner admitted for the first time that it told him only what the tower was doing at the instant he filled the cup.

They installed continuous temperature readings and a level float, allowing a small valve to correct deviations gradually. When wet material entered the yard, the receiving crew warned the tower room in advance. If temperature or pressure crossed a limit, an independent device shut off the steam and rang a bell. The apprentice still smelled the oil each day, but his nose was no longer the tower's only messenger.

When another cart of wet peel arrived, the owner reached by habit for the large valve. The smaller valve was already moving gently, and the reading had returned to its mark. He lowered his hand and walked downstairs to the tower's even ticking.
storyParagraphsZh: 山城的香油坊有座高蒸馏塔。老坊主每天日落时接一杯塔顶液体，闻过香气，再凭经验转动蒸汽阀。旧果皮来自同一片果园时，这办法很少出错，他便觉得多看几次只是浪费人手。
收成不好的一年，果皮开始从三处运来。有的晒得干，有的还带雨水。中午送来一车湿料，塔温慢慢下降，出来的油越来越淡，直到日落才被发现。坊主一口气把蒸汽开大，想把白天失去的香气补回来。夜里原料换成干料，塔温猛升，苦味也被带进了油里。
守夜学徒听见塔身发出从未有过的敲击声，赶紧关小阀门。半日的淡油和半夜的苦油都不能出售，婚礼季的订单只交出一半。坊主盯着日落时那杯样品，第一次承认它只告诉他塔在取样那一刻发生了什么。
他们在塔上装了连续读数的温度计和液位浮子，让小阀门随着偏差一点点调整；湿料进院时，前端便先通知塔房。若温度或压力越过界限，独立装置会关断蒸汽并敲铃。学徒仍每天闻油，但他的鼻子不再是塔唯一的消息。
又一车湿料到达时，坊主习惯性地伸手去转大阀。小阀正在轻轻移动，读数已回到刻线。他把手收回来，听着塔内均匀的滴答声走下楼梯。
explanationParagraphs: Process control keeps an operation stable under disturbances by continuously measuring its state, comparing it with a target, and manipulating inputs. Feedback corrects observed deviations; feedforward acts in advance on measured disturbances; alarms and interlocks protect operating limits. Performance also depends on sampling frequency, delay, and adjustment size. Corrections that arrive late and act too strongly often create oscillation or overshoot.
explanationParagraphsZh: 过程控制通过持续测量、比较目标与实际状态，并操纵输入，使运行在扰动下仍保持稳定。反馈根据已经出现的偏差修正，前馈利用可测扰动提前动作，警报与联锁则保护运行边界。控制效果还取决于采样频率、响应延迟和调节幅度；晚到且过大的修正常会引发振荡或过冲。

articles.title: The Net Asked to Stop a River
articles.summary: A ruler uses the finest net to make river water clear, then learns that clarity proves only that the mud was caught.
articles.summaryZh: 城主用最细的网把河水滤得清亮，却很快发现，清亮只证明泥沙被拦住了。
storyParagraphs: River City always found mud in its drinking water. After seeing a washerwoman strain water through cloth, the ruler ordered a vast net finer than window mesh to be stretched across the intake canal. On the first day, the water beyond it looked clear. People gathered around the basin in praise, and the ruler cancelled the money set aside for a settling pond.

A storm filled the fine net with branches and clods of mud until the canal nearly stopped. The day after workers cleared it, an upstream dye house spilled a barrel of colourless chemical. The water still looked clear but tasted bitter. Several days later, illness spread through the riverside streets. The physician found that the net caught mud, but not substances dissolved in water or unseen causes of disease.

The ruler proposed weaving an even tighter net. The water engineer placed stones, a spoonful of salt, and a drop of muddy water into three cups and let him see that the same net helped with only some of them. 'Ask one tool to do every job,' she said, 'and the first thing it may accomplish is blocking itself.'

The new works began with a coarse screen for branches, followed by a basin where sediment could settle. Separate layers of sand and charcoal addressed colour and odour, and a final disinfection step dealt with pathogens. Each stage had a sampling point, so a failure upstream could be found before the public became ill downstream.

When the works reopened, the ruler filled a cup with transparent water but did not raise it at once. He waited for three small flags at the screen, settling basin, and final reservoir to rise in sequence, and only then took the first drink.
storyParagraphsZh: 河城的饮水总带泥。城主看见洗衣妇用布滤水，便命人织出一张比窗纱还细的大网，拦在引水渠口。第一天，网后水色清亮，百姓围着水池称赞，城主也撤掉了原本准备修沉淀池的钱。
一场暴雨下来，树枝和泥团把细网堵得严严实实，水渠几乎断流。工人清完网的第二天，上游染坊又打翻一桶无色药液。水看起来仍旧清澈，喝下去却有苦味。几日后，河边街巷出现腹病，医官发现细网能拦泥，却拦不住溶在水里的东西，也杀不掉看不见的病源。
城主想把网再织密一层。管水匠却把一把石子、一勺盐和一滴浑水分别倒进三只杯子，让他亲眼看见同一张网只对其中一些东西有用。‘让一件工具做所有事，’她说，‘它最先做成的往往只是堵住自己。’
新水渠先用粗栅拦树枝，再让泥沙在池中沉下；后面另有沙炭层处理颜色和异味，最后一道消毒才对付病源。每一处都留下取水口，若前段失常，后段不会等到百姓生病才知道。
水厂重新开门时，城主接了一杯透明的水，却没有立刻举杯。他等粗栅、沉淀池和末端水池的三面小旗依次升起，才喝下第一口。
explanationParagraphs: A treatment train uses connected stages for contaminants that differ in nature and cannot be removed reliably by one operation. Early stages reduce loads and protect later ones; downstream stages address finer or different hazards. Monitoring points and appropriate redundancy help detect failure. The sequence should be selected for the contaminants, variation in incoming water, and required standard, rather than by simply adding equipment.
explanationParagraphsZh: 处理工艺链把性质不同、单一步骤难以同时去除的污染物，交给相互衔接的多个处理单元。前段可削减负荷并保护后段，后段处理更细或不同类型的风险；监测点与必要冗余帮助发现失效。工艺选择应依据污染物、来水变化和目标标准，而不是简单堆叠设备。

articles.title: The Chimney That Kept Growing
articles.summary: A kiln yard answers every smoke complaint by raising its chimney, until soot falling on a distant reservoir returns in the whole city's drinking water.
articles.summaryZh: 窑场每收到一次烟尘投诉就把烟囱加高，直到落在远处水库上的黑灰又被全城喝了回来。
storyParagraphs: While the imperial kiln rushed to make roof tiles for a new palace, black smoke settled on nearby washing lines. Stopping the furnaces would miss the deadline, so the kiln master raised the chimney by thirty feet. The air beside the yard became clean, and he pointed to the blue sky and said the problem had travelled away with the wind.

Two weeks later, orchard growers from the eastern fields arrived with soot-marked pears. The master raised the chimney another thirty feet. Smoke crossed the orchards and fell on villages beyond the hill. Later, a north wind carried fine ash into the reservoir, and the next morning every water jar in the city had a black rim. The chimney was now visible from outside the city; no one could claim the ash belonged elsewhere.

A young kiln engineer stopped one furnace and opened its feed system and doors. She found damp, smoky coal, cracks drawing unwanted air, and glaze powder swept away whenever material was charged. The master urged her to add one more section to the chimney. Instead, she put three days of delay under her own name, changed to dry coal, sealed the doors, altered the charging chute, and collected the remaining dust at the outlet.

When firing resumed three days later, the same number of tiles used less coal and produced lighter smoke. The outlet equipment remained because some residue was unavoidable, but it was no longer being asked to handle the dense stream previously created by the process itself.

The master ordered the newest bricks removed from the top of the chimney. They were not discarded. Workers carried them to the furnaces and built them into the door frames that had once leaked air. When the final brick was laid, the mason's palms were still red.
storyParagraphsZh: 官窑赶制新宫瓦时，黑烟落满附近晾衣绳。停窑会误了限期，窑长便把烟囱加高三丈。窑边的空气果然干净了，他指着蓝天说，问题已经随风走远。
半个月后，东郊果农带着沾灰的梨来告状。窑长又加高三丈，烟越过果园，落到山后的村子。再后来，一场北风把细灰送进水库，第二天城里的水缸都浮着一圈黑边。烟囱已经高得能从城外看见，谁也不能再说那些灰不属于官窑。
年轻窑师停下一座窑，拆开进料和炉门。她找到受潮冒烟的煤、漏风的裂缝，以及每次投料时被气流卷走的釉粉。窑长催她先把烟囱再接一段，她却把三天工期写在自己名下，换干煤、封炉门、改投料槽，并在出口收集剩下的粉尘。
三天后复烧，同样数量的瓦用了更少的煤，烟也淡了。出口装置仍然保留，因为不可能一点残余都没有；可它处理的已不再是原先那股不断被制造出来的浓烟。
窑长命人拆下烟囱最上面的新砖。那些砖没有丢掉，而是被运到炉前，砌进了原本漏风的门框。最后一块砖落下时，砌砖人的手掌仍是红的。
explanationParagraphs: Source control changes materials, equipment, or operations before pollution or waste is created, preventing or reducing its formation. A taller chimney changes where pollutants disperse without reducing their total amount. End-of-pipe treatment remains useful for unavoidable residual emissions. In practice, prevention and reduction generally come first, followed by recovery or reuse, then treatment and safe disposal of what remains.
explanationParagraphsZh: 源头控制优先在污染或废物产生之前改变材料、设备与操作，以避免或减少其形成。加高烟囱只改变污染物的扩散位置，并未减少总量；末端治理则适合处理无法避免的剩余排放。实践中通常先预防和减量，再回收利用，最后对残余进行处理与安全处置。

articles.title: Before the Cup Held Tea
articles.summary: An innkeeper seeks the cleanest cup for serving tea and discovers that a cup's story begins before the tea and continues after the guest leaves.
articles.summaryZh: 客栈老板想选出最清洁的茶杯，却发现一只杯子的故事早在装茶之前开始，也不会在客人喝完时结束。
storyParagraphs: After the spring fair, the inn yard was piled with paper cups discarded after one use. The owner, Madam Qin, called them wasteful and immediately ordered five hundred thick ceramic cups from another province, each stamped 'the lasting choice' underneath. Their delivery required three heavy carts, and forty broke on the journey. She had not counted the firing of the cups or the wood and water needed to wash them each day.

The first month was worse. Travellers carried cups away without thinking, servers broke a batch, and the washroom heated water all day. The paper merchant said ceramic used more resources; the potter pointed to the rubbish pile and said paper had to be remade every day. They argued at the counter, each describing only the part of the journey that favoured his own goods.

The bookkeeper placed a pot of tea on the table. 'Are we comparing one cup,' he asked, 'or the serving of one hundred pots of tea?' Beginning with clay digging and tree cutting, he recorded manufacture, transport, use, washing, number of returns, and final destination. He kept fuel, water, breakage, and recovery in separate columns.

No cup won by its nature alone. If a ceramic cup was used twice, the burden of firing and transport was difficult to recover. With a small deposit, efficient shared washing, and dozens of uses, its cost per serving fell. Madam Qin used ceramic for guests staying at the inn. At the takeaway stall, where returns were uncertain, she kept light paper cups and required the supplier to collect them.

At the end of summer, a traveller returned a ceramic cup and reclaimed his deposit. Madam Qin turned the cup over, carved one more mark beside the thirty-six fine scratches already on its base, and placed it back in the basin of hot water.
storyParagraphsZh: 春市过后，客栈后院堆满用过即丢的纸杯。老板秦娘嫌它们浪费，立刻从外省订来五百只厚陶杯，还在杯底印上‘长久之选’。陶杯运到时用了三辆重车，途中碎了四十只；开窑烧杯和每日洗杯的柴水，她原先都没算。
头一个月更糟。赶路的客人顺手带走杯子，伙计摔破了一批，洗杯房整日烧水。纸杯商说陶杯反而更费，陶匠则指着垃圾堆说纸杯每天都要重做。两人争到柜台前，谁都只拿对自己有利的一段路说话。
账房在桌上放了一壶茶，问：‘我们究竟比较一只杯子，还是比较把一百壶茶送到客人手里？’他从取土与伐木开始，依次记下制造、运输、使用、清洗、重复次数和最后去向，还把柴、水、破损与回收分别列开。
算过以后，没有哪只杯子天然获胜。陶杯若只用两次，前面的烧制和运输很难抵回；若押一枚小钱、集中清洗并用上几十次，每杯茶承担的耗费便会下降。秦娘给堂食客人用陶杯，难以收回杯子的外带摊仍用轻纸杯，并要求供应商回收。
夏末，一名旅人把陶杯送回柜台，取回押钱。秦娘翻过杯底，在原有的三十六道细划痕旁又刻了一道，然后把它放回热水盆。
explanationParagraphs: Life-cycle assessment compares products or services against a defined functional unit, following raw-material extraction, manufacture, transport, use, maintenance, reuse, and final disposal. Energy, materials, and emissions are translated into environmental impact indicators. Results depend on system boundaries, data, reuse rates, and assumptions, so one stage or a 'reusable' label cannot decide the outcome. The story uses serving one hundred pots of tea as the common function needed for a fair comparison.
explanationParagraphsZh: 生命周期评价以明确的功能单位比较产品或服务，从原料取得、制造和运输，一直追踪到使用、维护、重复利用与最终处置，并把能源、物料和排放转换为若干环境影响指标。结论取决于系统边界、数据、使用次数和假设，不能只凭某一阶段或‘可重复使用’标签判断。故事以供应一百壶茶为共同功能，才使不同杯子能够公平比较。
